name: Lehren's Ship
description: A fair-sized fishing vessel on which the hooded villagers sail onto Lake Zhava.

timeline.summary: Mia watches hooded villagers load sheep carcasses onto Lehren's ship and sees Wilbur among them.
timeline.quote: Wilbur gave one last lingering gaze into the woods before turning to board.

timeline.summary: Mia leaps onto the departing ship and clings to its stern ladder as it sails onto the fog-bound lake.
timeline.quote: hanging on the small ladder on the stern

timeline.summary: Kalim announces that the sheep of the slayer's daughter are being sacrificed to the Gitrog.
timeline.quote: Tonight we gift the Gitrog with the sheep of the slayer's daughter.

timeline.summary: Mia knocks out Lehren with her crossbow and confronts the hooded villagers as they toss carcasses overboard.
timeline.quote: dropped like a sack of potatoes

timeline.summary: Mia accuses the villagers of having killed her sheep a few at a time; Kalim insists everyone has seen the Gitrog and must feed it.
timeline.quote: There is no Gitrog! You destroyed my pen and slaughtered my herd!

timeline.summary: The Gitrog's tongue hurls Veryl off the ship and he disappears into the water.
timeline.quote: Veryl went flying backward off the ship, screaming through the air, and disappeared with a splash into the water.

timeline.summary: Villagers, led by Sarah, turn on Mia and demand she be sacrificed to the Gitrog.
timeline.quote: Kill her! A sacrifice to the Gitrog!

timeline.summary: Mia fights off hooded attackers, including Kyle and Terrance, shooting one assailant in the stomach.
timeline.quote: The grip loosened and she turned around and fired blindly into the stomach of her assailant.

timeline.summary: Wilbur knocks out Terrance, apologizes that things got out of hand, and says he has only ever seen bubbles.
timeline.quote: I'm so sorry. Everything got out of hand.

timeline.summary: Kalim declares the only answer is sacrifice and tries to cut Mia's throat; Wilbur tackles him.
timeline.quote: Kalim lunged forward, fishing knife suddenly drawn and in his hand, swinging straight for Mia's throat.

timeline.summary: The Gitrog climbs aboard and devours Kalim just as he offers Mia in sacrifice.
timeline.quote: Mia watched in horror as Kalim's head disappeared into its gullet

pages_say.description: A fair-sized fishing vessel on which the hooded villagers sail onto Lake Zhava.
